# Demo test data

These raw PCM files are ~30-second excerpts of **public-domain** LibriVox
audiobook recordings, decoded to mono PCM at the sample rates and formats a
TTS backend typically emits.  They stand in for a TTS engine's output in the
`demo` example.

LibriVox recordings are released into the public domain
(https://librivox.org/pages/public-domain), so no attribution is required and
they may be freely redistributed.

| File                                   | Source recording                              | Format          |
| -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------------- |
| `librivox-austen-24kHz-s16le-mono.raw` | *Pride and Prejudice* (Jane Austen), LibriVox | 24 kHz · s16le  |
| `librivox-austen-24kHz-f32le-mono.raw` | *Pride and Prejudice* (Jane Austen), LibriVox | 24 kHz · f32le  |
| `librivox-suntzu-16kHz-s16le-mono.raw` | *The Art of War* (Sun Tzu), LibriVox          | 16 kHz · s16le  |
| `librivox-suntzu-8kHz-s16le-mono.raw`  | *The Art of War* (Sun Tzu), LibriVox          | 8 kHz · s16le   |

Sources:
- https://archive.org/details/pride_and_prejudice_librivox
- https://archive.org/details/art_of_war_librivox
